body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units. It may immediately move 1 unit and becomes Rallied if that movement brings it adjacent to an enemy or objective.

surges.html: Remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked from one affected ally.
Reduce forced movement against one affected ally by 1 unit until your next turn.

rider.title: SIGNAL — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority after an enemy declares an Action: 1–3 one ally may move 1 unit; 4–5 two allies may each move 1 unit; 6+ one ally may immediately use a Basic Reaction if eligible.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
